objective.primaryRule: reference method NL0: the actual-profit role of the C24 final selectable set under the session hold unit (independent and informed shortlists and the controls New L0, C4, C4-refined, C85 under sessions): the highest development centre net among qualified members (gates Q1-Q6; the fresh confirmation decides qualification), ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre DD, then the label; the controls are the qualifying-incumbent fallback (New L0 under sessions = the brief's B). The independent and informed primaries and every role are kept; at C19/C21/C23 the fold primary is the independent actual-profit role (PROTOCOL.md §9).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals (centres): independent 24,576 base / 49,152 maximum per cutoff x 4 cutoffs (6 replicates x 3 V sub-cells with 5B's V, G and B schedules); informed <= 12,570 base / <= 21,786 maximum at C24 (6 replicates); <= 110,874 base / <= 218,394 maximum (refinement moves counted apart). Against the original (reference method NL0 §4): the 5B L0 arm's configured base 36,802 and executed 49,346 proposals, 489,695 requested search evaluations, 64,554 qualification evaluations; the whole 5B study's base 110,406. Backend evaluations: the 3,000,000 planning ceiling of fresh simulations, enforced by 5B's frozen per-job caps summing to 2,865,000 (PROTOCOL.md §7.4; resource guard on extension rounds). Counted separately: screen, rung-1/2/3 and refinement centres and neighbours, qualification, cross-tests, folds, sequential, diagnostics, validation, retries (runs.jsonl) and archive hits.
